question: Which company agreed to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control?

hits.title: ASSA ABLOY to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control.
hits.snippet: Gunnebo Entrance Control reported 2025 sales of approximately €151 million with a solid EBIT margin.

hits.title: ASSA ABLOY to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control.
hits.snippet: STOCKHOLM, Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of entrance control solutions, including speed gates, mass transit gates and security revolving doors.

hits.title: Gunnebo Entrance Control launches HiSec Nova security portal with new detection and control technologies.
hits.snippet: Gunnebo Entrance Control has introduced HiSec Nova, a new security portal that incorporates three newly developed technologies focused on occupancy detection, drive control and system intelligence.

hits.title: Gunnebo Entrance Control introduces HiSec Nova security portal.
hits.snippet: HiSec Nova also introduces SmoothDrive, a newly developed drive mechanism engineered to improve portal operation and long-term performance.

hits.title: Gunnebo QTicket: streamline venue entry management.
hits.snippet: * Gunnebo launches QTicket for efficient venue entry using multiple entrance technologies.

hits.title: Digital gates and contactless payments are transforming Welsh rail.
hits.snippet: Vix Technology, a leader in fare collection and intelligent transportation systems, and Gunnebo Entrance Control partnered with Transport for Wales Rail (TfWRL), the rail operations business that sits within Transport for Wales, to enable the launch of the first Pay as you Go (PAYG) contactless system on heavy rail outside of London.

hits.title: Gunnebo acquires Shuretech: Enhancing UK security services
hits.snippet: Gunnebo acquires Shuretech: enhancing UK security services.

hits.title: Gunnebo's NexGate reinforces retail loss prevention
hits.snippet: Gunnebo Entrance Control has introduced NexGate, a new entrance management system tailored for retail environments with self-checkout options.

hits.title: Gunnebo showcases intelligent airport entrance solutions
hits.snippet: Gunnebo Entrance Control is set to make a return to the Passenger Terminal Expo in 2026, presenting its latest intelligent entrance control solutions that aim to enhance secure, efficient, and passenger-friendly airport environments.

hits.title: PAYG tap-on, tap-off drives rapid growth in Welsh rail ticketing
hits.snippet: Vix Technology and Gunnebo Entrance Control have partnered with Transport for Wales rail to deliver the first pay as you go (PAYG) contactless system on heavy rail outside london, with early results pointing to strong passenger uptake.

accuracy.note: Answer matches gold acquirer ASSA ABLOY

ar.note: Ranks 1 and 2 state ASSA ABLOY agreed to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control; others are unrelated product/partnership news.
